title: EBM Audit v3 planning and v2 preparation identities

ChoiceParameterValue.$comment: String and array values are only representable here. Acceptance additionally requires an authenticated public-intent manifest, a closed enum/const string or bounded scalar-array schema, complete-value JCS equality to one authorized manifest value, and the typed path-aware private-token scan.

PublicIntentManifestDigestPreimage.$comment: Pre-data public namespace owner issued only from verified run configuration plus authenticated Describe, without a prepared dataset, profile, participant count, budget, or runtime input. Private paths, physical DataVariant labels, and provenance strings are rejection tokens only and never enter manifest content. The manifest owns exact caller-controlled public identifiers used inside AnalysisSpec values, source variants, experiments, axes, choices, members, operation methods, and generic settings. An AnalysisSpec content digest is a deterministic name, not a manifest identifier or authority. Compiler-generated hashes, declarations, rationales, origins, ordinals, candidates, and chain IDs are excluded and independently rebuilt. Before a planning authority is issued, one schema- and path-aware extractor scans only caller- or data-derived public content in the rebuilt plan and manifest against private source-column, raw-label, physical-variant-label, provenance, participant-token, and path namespaces. Fixed schema tags, namespaces, versions, statuses, enum values, and rule literals are structural and are never scanned.

CoreSettingsRegistryDigestPreimage.$comment: Source-controlled core schemas only. Worker backend settings schemas remain authenticated Describe evidence and are not duplicated here.

PreparationRuleDefinition.$comment: Preparation rules never own PLAN_INELIGIBLE. Each failure reason must use a code explicitly owned by its applied rule; PREPARED records carry no reasons.

CohortIntent.$comment: Validation-issued row-free cohort intent. Physical source columns and raw group labels remain only in the sealed validation/preparation capability.

OutlierPolicy.$comment: policy_kind is execution semantics, not a caller label. none is the exact no-op tuple; tukey-iqr is the only non-no-op family and requires a positive IQR multiplier, a non-none reference population, a scope-compatible action, and an explicit closed transform method when values change.

ScientificFitRequestedOutput.$comment: Transport-neutral scientific output vocabulary. Worker request and response schema versions are deliberately outside AnalysisSpec/3.

BackendSpec.$comment: Transport-free scientific backend choice. Protocol, request, response, payload, wire, runtime, and worker-executable versions are forbidden.

ScientificBackendRegistryDigestPreimage.$comment: Complete canonically ordered set of every selectable scientific backend owner. Transport and runtime identities are forbidden.

DatasetVariantIntent.$comment: A row-free SourceVariantDefinition projection. Source tables, derived tables, truth, paths, and data digests are preparation evidence and are forbidden here.

OperationIntent.$comment: Pre-data operation intent only. Realized row selections, fixed-cohort membership digests, seeds, and transformation manifests are forbidden.

DeclarationProvenanceRecord.$comment: source_declaration_digest is the domain-separated digest of the complete closed declaration-provenance core. It owns declaration labels and rationales only; no field affects worker execution.

AnalysisSpec.$comment: Scientific choices only. mcmc is non-null exactly when the authenticated adapter semantics declares an AVAILABLE AdapterMcmcProjection; a NON_CHAIN_ALGORITHM uses null and cannot own an MCMC axis or settings. The complete closed object is the AnalysisSpec/3 content-name preimage. Its digest is deterministic but is never a capability; transport, worker runtime, evaluator, rows, seeds, and private values are forbidden.

ChainPlanSlot.description: One authenticated execution slot. Non-sampling algorithms own exactly one slot; sampling algorithms may own multiple chain slots.
ChainPlanSlot.$comment: A Plan/3 seedless authenticated execution slot. Exact non-sampling planned algorithms own exactly one slot; sampling algorithms use one slot per declared chain. Seeds do not exist at the planning boundary.

ChainPlanIdentityRow.$comment: chain_id is core-derived exactly as chain-{chain_ordinal:04d}; it is not caller-chosen.

PreparationAggregateCounts.$comment: Staged public totals only: source S, cohort-eligible C, pre-operation-eligible P, operation output Oi/Ou, fit-ready training Ti/Tu, and fixed evaluation E. Oi-Ou is the added duplicate-instance count for replacement sampling; ingestion row manifests remain unique. Exact membership, ordered instances, occurrence ordinals, stratum allocation, and cell attribution remain in PrivatePreparationReplay.

UniverseSpec.$comment: The sole executable UniverseSpec/3 for one PREPARED AnalysisPlan/3 candidate. candidate_id and analysis_spec_id are equal by the Plan/3 invariant. evaluation_membership_digest is run/plan-scoped linkable commitment evidence for exact fixed-cohort equality; it is not anonymization and cannot be publicly replayed. Exact rows, identifiers, paths, and tokens are forbidden.

CandidateOrigin.$comment: The complete ordered choice vector is required because a factorial or declared combination can originate from multiple axes. Non-axis modes use an empty vector.

DeclarationResolution.$comment: Compiler-derived origin resolution, keyed and ordered by globally unique origin_id. One declaration-family ID may repeat across its bootstrap, subsample, null, or influence expansions; those origins may also converge with other origins on one deduplicated AnalysisSpec.

OriginComparisonEdge.$comment: One core-derived edge per CandidateOrigin. Comparison semantics are computed from the two executable AnalysisSpecs and are never caller assertions.

StaticPlanningReason.$comment: Every Plan/3 ineligibility reason is one exact code-and-rule pair. The compiler and independent verifier derive the pair; callers cannot mix codes and rules.

AnalysisCandidate.$comment: candidate_id and analysis_spec_id are equal by invariant. within_fit_chain_uncertainty_status is derived exactly from AnalysisSpec.mcmc. PLANNED sampling algorithms require authenticated AVAILABLE MCMC semantics and have one seedless slot per declared chain. An authenticated NON_CHAIN_ALGORITHM with null MCMC intent, false sampler-history capabilities, and no requested sampler-history outputs is PLANNED with one execution slot while within-fit chain uncertainty remains unavailable. Other MCMC-unavailable candidates are PLAN_INELIGIBLE with the exact MCMC-unavailable reason, zero chain slots, and zero fit ceiling. Preparation-time failures never appear here.

AnalysisPlanCounts.$comment: Static planning counts only. Global candidate and fit counts are unique AnalysisSpecs. Partition origin_count values count origin-to-candidate associations, while candidate and fit fields deduplicate a candidate within each scope.

PlanningConfigDigestPreimage.$comment: Closed row-free and seed-free planning input owner. Input bytes, prepared-data identities, master/operation/chain seeds, output paths, and runtime evidence are forbidden.

InfluenceExpansionCardinality.$comment: eligible_target_count is the exact declared removal scope after any explicit config-owned selection rule. With no selection it equals the complete prepared participant count.

ReplicatedOperationExpansionCardinality.$comment: null_family_id is part of a null replicate scope so distinct same-method families retain independent ordinal sequences. Bootstrap and subsample use null.

DeclaredOperationExpansions.$comment: Row-free declarations projected from the exact run-eligible config. Replicate counts and named-group IDs are configuration intent, not data-derived validation summaries.

PlanningDatasetSummary.$comment: Safe aggregates projected from the exact PreparedAuditDataset capability. Influence cardinalities are scoped by their complete source tuple so expansion and conservative fit ceilings are auditable without rows or identifiers.

SelectedAlgorithmBinding.$comment: The sole exact ten-field projection is produced by AuthenticatedWorkerDescription. Planning and invocation consume this canonical object and compare it independently with their configured owners; no competing builder is permitted.

ValidatedPlanningSummaryBindingPreimage.$comment: Runtime-only identity owner for a sealed validation capability. Its exact source/config bindings never enter AnalysisPlan; only the safe planning_dataset_summary projection does. The production issuer belongs to validation and must consume genuine RunEligibleAuditConfig, PreparedAuditDataset, and authenticated worker describe capabilities.

RuntimeEstimate.$comment: A safe historical planning estimate. It never contains current prepared-data evidence or private values.

BudgetDecision.$comment: The ordinary-candidate ceiling applies only to operation_intent.kind=ordinary. The fit ceiling and maximum exact removals in any one declared influence scope are independent limits. max_parallel_workers is the selected profile's positive whole-candidate execution ceiling; it never authorizes splitting one candidate's chains. reason_codes is the canonical ordered list of every exceeded ceiling; influence scopes are never truncated to make a plan fit.

AnalysisPlanCore.$comment: A pre-realization plan. The plan directly owns the one baseline identity, exact declaration provenance coverage, and one derived comparison edge per origin. Verification requires the genuine PreparedAuditDataset capability and recomputes this safe aggregate projection, while the persisted plan remains free of exact source/prepared-data commitments, UniverseSpec, seeds, and realization evidence.

AnalysisPlanDigestPreimage.$comment: The one exact ebm-audit/analysis-plan/3 preimage. The plan_digest member is absent, not null.

AnalysisPlan.$comment: Persisted plan. plan_digest is non-null and MUST equal the domain-separated digest of the exact AnalysisPlanDigestPreimage projection.

PreparationReason.$comment: A typed public-safe reason only. Raw values, identifiers, row indexes, paths, exceptions, and free-form data excerpts are forbidden.

PlanIneligiblePreparationRecord.$comment: A projection of the candidate's exact static planning outcome: no preparation rule is applied and reasons are copied byte-for-byte from planning_reasons.

PreparationReceiptDigestPreimage.$comment: The complete ebm-audit/preparation-receipt/2 preimage. PlanningAuthority creates it internally from one exact WITHIN_BUDGET AnalysisPlan/3. Records are the complete ordered candidate sequence; receipt_digest is absent, not null.

RequestedOutputsPreimage.$comment: Command-neutral output-set identity. Command eligibility is enforced separately at each request boundary.
